sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Two new menus in the page heading, after ❓ Help and a divider: ⚠️ WARNING and ❌ ERROR. Each lists every kind of data problem the page has, with a descriptive label, a glyph, a tooltip and how many rows have it — track and recording length differ or far apart, recording without a work, video on a medium that cannot carry video, live-title dates that are impossible, near misses or written with a plain "-", ALL UPPERCASE and truncated titles, track ≠ recording name, 🟠 low data quality, invalid ISRC/ISWC/barcode, pending edits, and live-recording credits without a date or with a different date. Clicking a row shows only the rows with that problem in every table and sub-table at once; clicking it again shows everything. Rows combine with each other and with every other filter (two in one column: either; in different columns: both). A trailing "✗ Clear warning/error filters" row removes only what that menu set. A menu is hidden while the page has nothing of its kind, and its counts always describe the whole page, never just the rows a filter leaves on screen. Behind the new setting "Enable the ⚠️ WARNING / ❌ ERROR menus" (⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ FINDINGS, on by default).

Most menu rows work by ticking the matching entry of the new 📊 sections "Findings - Warning" and "Findings - Error" in the column that holds the problem, so the column's filter box shows it and every way of clearing a column filter clears it. Problems that can sit in several different columns of one row (pending edits, live credit dates) filter by row instead and show a chip beside the global filter, with a ✕ to remove it.

Problems that had no highlight of their own are now tinted like the others — light yellow with ⚠️ — each behind its own setting in ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ FINDINGS (all on by default): ALL UPPERCASE titles, truncated titles, track ≠ recording name, low data quality, cells with pending edits, and the cells of invalid ISRCs, ISWCs and barcodes and of undated live credits (these keep their own ⚠️ and get the tint only; a live credit with a different date is tinted red). Turning a tint off keeps the problem in the menu.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: The filter bar's live-date "(N) WARNING ⚠️ / (N) ERROR ❌" buttons and its "(N) LENGTH ⚠️/❌" buttons are replaced by the ⚠️ WARNING / ❌ ERROR menus. The live-date buttons used to clear every other filter and type their glyph into the global filter; the menu rows now compose with your filters instead. The ⏳ pending-edits toggles stay as they are; the menu's "Pending edits" row is a separate, page-wide filter.
